items.briefing:
Australians are being warned about active scam campaigns impersonating myGov and using fake invoices to steal personal and financial information. These phishing attacks look convincing, so be cautious of any unexpected emails or messages claiming to be from myGov or requesting urgent payment.

Separately, research shows many Australian businesses are adopting AI tools faster than they're putting proper rules and oversight in place, creating potential security and compliance risks. If your workplace is using AI tools, check whether your organisation has clear guidelines on how they should be used safely.

**Tip:** Never click links in unexpected myGov emails — go directly to myGov.com.au by typing it into your browser.

featured.title: Proofpoint warns of myGov & invoice scams in Australia
featured.quote: Australians lost $2.18 billion to scams in 2025, with myGov and invoice fraud as primary vectors.
